alex: Hey team — PR #4309 is stuck in the merge queue, need one more LGTM. CI keeps failing on a UI snapshot (render_diff) on shard-7. I ran a targeted rerun twice and it still fails. Can @maria or @jordan take a quick look? ci-bot: [CI] build #4309 — shard-7 failed: test_ui_render_snapshot. Error snippet: ``` AssertionError: snapshot mismatch at renderDiff (ui/test/snapshot.test.ts:88:12) at kv.lookup('user-theme') -> returned null ``` maria: I can look in ~15m. Do you have the failing diff or artifact link? alex: Pasted below (small excerpt): ```diff -
Welcome
+
Welcome
``` Note: only fails on linux-amd64 shard-7, mac + windows are green. jordan: Could be cache ordering — PR 4298 touched render cache ordering earlier. Any way to repro locally with a fixed seed? alex: Tried `yarn test ui --shard=7 --seed=42` — couldn't repro. CI env stack shows `kv.lookup('user-theme')` intermittently returning null, which lines up with the missing class. sam: infra check — shard-7 image rolled a kernel patch this morning but we pinned images after. I'll double-check env drift and whether the kv service had transient errors. pinging @eng-sre to verify. leah: If it's nondet and blocking merge, can we temporarily mute just the flaky assertion and open a follow-up flaky-ticket? Otherwise this will sit in the queue. maria: I'll take this. Trying a targeted rerun with kv cache cleared and will upload artifacts. alex, please don't trigger more reruns so we don't spam the queue. ci-bot: [CI] targeted rerun requested by maria — build #4309.2 queued (priority: high). alex: :thumbsup: If 4309.2 passes, could someone approve? I didn't change rendering logic intentionally. maria: Quick update — 4309.2 passed. Artifacts: http://ci.internal/artifacts/4309.2/snapshot.png. Looks like a timing/race in test setup. I'm adding a tiny stability wait in the test and will push a patch in a minute. jordan: Thanks — once you push the fix I'll give an LGTM and we can merge. alex: Great, thanks everyone. I'll remove the merge hold after the new commit lands.
